title: Transactions
emptyFiltered: Nothing matches the search or filters.

form.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
form.notesTooLong: Notes can be at most 1000 characters.
form.transferNotice: This is one side of a transfer. Amount, date and notes also change on the other side.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.noEnd: Never (tap to set an end date)
repeat.installmentsHint: Creates every installment now. The first follows the status above; the rest start pending.
repeat.recurringHint: Saves this transaction and a recurring entry that adds the next ones when they're due.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.marketRate: Leave blank for the market rate
transfer.crossCurrencyHint: The accounts use different currencies. Enter what arrived, or leave it blank to use that day's rate.
transfer.fromRequired: Choose where the money comes from.

scope.thisHint: The others stay as they are.
scope.futureHint: Earlier installments stay as they are.

deleteTransferBody: Both sides of the transfer will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

similar.title: Similar transactions
similar.heading: Use {{category}} for this vendor?
similar.intro: Give this vendor's other transactions the same category, and every new one that comes in. This saves a rule you can change later under More → Rules.
similar.payeeHint: Matches every transaction with this payee.
similar.containsHint: From "{{description}}". Remove store numbers or dates so every visit matches.
similar.overwrite: Change ones that already have a category
similar.overwriteHint: Off: only fill in uncategorized transactions.
similar.doneFuture: New transactions from {{vendor}} will go to {{category}}.
